_comment: env_prefix shortens UBIQUITI_UNIFI_NETWORK_* to UNIFI_*, which is what a
controller is called in practice. TLS_INSECURE is an alias for the shared
option set's tls_disable_validation, because a self-signed controller
certificate is the normal case on a LAN and nobody types the long name.
The two invariant skips match this integration's fixture scenarios: the
UniFi API's stable identifier for a client IS its MAC, so the script has
no tenant-scoped id to use and no_mac_in_id/namespaced_ids cannot hold.
Remove both skips if the id scheme is ever revisited -- a live controller
is where a randomized-MAC collision would first show up.
